GameConditionDef.label: the green leaning
GameConditionDef.description: The plants all lean toward one tree, and leaves and seeds drift toward it even though there is no wind. The dryads stand still. Plants grow faster while it lasts.

li.namedText: {NAME} is listening. The plants all lean toward one tree, leaves and seeds drift toward it with no wind, and the dryads stand still. Plants grow faster, and anyone who fells a tree now feels bad about it.

GameConditionDef.label: warm stone
GameConditionDef.description: The rock is warm to the touch, steam rises from cracks in it and a little ash falls. Ore shows in the rock faces, and rooms dug into the mountain are warmer.

li.namedText: {NAME} breathes under the mountain. The rock is warm, steam rises from cracks in it, a little ash falls and ore shows in the rock faces. Rooms dug into the rock are warmer still, and anyone who sleeps there may hear a warm voice.

GameConditionDef.label: the white beast grazing
GameConditionDef.description: A great white beast is grazing on the land. The wild animals near it lie down and graze peacefully and won't attack anyone, and the colony's people quarrel less.

li.namedText: {NAME} is passing over the land. The wild animals near him lie down and graze peacefully and won't attack anyone, and there are fewer quarrels while he grazes.

GameConditionDef.label: spore-fall
GameConditionDef.description: Pale spores drift in the air and glow faintly after dark, and mushrooms have come up in rings. Food left out of the cold and the bodies of the dead rot faster, mushrooms grow faster and sicknesses pass more quickly.

li.namedText: {NAME} is close. Pale spores drift in the air and mushrooms come up in rings. Anything left out of the cold rots fast, the dead go back to the earth sooner, mushrooms grow faster and sicknesses pass more quickly.

GameConditionDef.label: a warm evening
GameConditionDef.description: The evening is warm and the hearths burn long and bright. People talk more kindly than usual, the animals follow the stranger around, and every visitor seems glad to be here.

li.namedText: {NAME} is under the colony's roof. The hearths burn long and warm, people talk kindly, the animals follow the guest around, and every visitor is glad to be here.

GameConditionDef.label: a hum in the wires
GameConditionDef.description: Every light pulses softly in a pattern and the machines hum. Batteries lose less charge, the powered benches work faster, and one door won't open for one person until someone else opens it.

li.namedText: {NAME} is awake in the wires. The lights pulse in a pattern, batteries lose less charge, the powered benches work faster, and one door won't open for one person until someone else opens it.

GameConditionDef.label: a sky too high
GameConditionDef.description: The sky is unusually clear and high, and the weather stays the same. There is lightning over the far hills but no rain, the birds have gone, and people who look up feel as if something is watching them.

li.namedText: {NAME} is looking down. The sky is unusually clear and high, the weather stays the same, there is lightning over the far hills but no rain, and people who look up feel watched.

GameConditionDef.label: a white silence
GameConditionDef.description: Everything has gone white and silent. Nobody speaks, the cold deepens, frost forms along the walls and nothing left out of doors rots. The old, the sick and small children feel the cold first.

li.namedText: {NAME} is near. Nobody speaks, the cold deepens, frost forms along the walls and nothing out of doors rots, the dead included. The old, the sick and small children feel the cold first.

GameConditionDef.label: the dark
GameConditionDef.description: It is darker than it should be. Lamps don't reach as far as they did, one corner of the colony stays dark however well it is lit, and people's minds are more open to psychic influence.

GameConditionDef.label: the long noon
GameConditionDef.description: The sun seems to stand still in the sky, and the daylight stays as it is. The air warms, solar panels give more power and the crops grow fast. Night owls and those the sun burns can't rest.

li.namedText: {NAME} is staring down. The daylight stays as it is, the air warms, solar panels give more power and the crops grow fast. Night owls and those the sun burns can't rest.

GameConditionDef.label: a moon too close
GameConditionDef.description: The moon hangs huge and close over the land. The fuller it is, the lighter the night, and those asleep under it heal faster and dream deeply.

li.namedText: {NAME} is watching. The fuller her face, the lighter the night; those asleep under her heal faster and dream deeply, and a dream at the full moon may come true.

GameConditionDef.label: a croaking in the wells
GameConditionDef.description: A deep croaking comes up from the wells and the wet ground, felt in the chest. Frogs are out, water stands by the well and rain is coming. Plants on wet ground grow faster.

li.namedText: {NAME} is singing down in the wells. The croak is felt in the chest, the frogs are out, water stands by the well, the rain is coming and the wells run clean.

GameConditionDef.label: a glint
GameConditionDef.description: Coins glint in the stores, a golden beetle has crossed a table, and a few coins lie in a trail toward the edge of the land. Traders give the colony better prices.

li.namedText: {NAME} is going by. Coins glint in the stores and lie in a trail toward the edge of the land, and traders give the colony better prices.

GameConditionDef.label: a merry air
GameConditionDef.description: A sweet smoke drifts about the place though nothing is burning, and now and then someone laughs in an empty room. People enjoy themselves more easily.

li.namedText: {NAME} is at the table. A sweet smoke drifts about though nothing is burning, someone laughs in an empty room, and people enjoy themselves more easily for a while.

li.label: a warm evening
li.description: The hearths are burning long tonight, and everyone's kinder for it.

li.label: a warm evening
li.description: It's warm here, and the people are kind. A good place to stop.

li.label: the sun won't go down
li.description: The sun just hangs there. My eyes ache and I can't rest.

li.label: the axe felt wrong
li.description: I felled a tree while everything green was leaning, and the axe felt wrong in my hands the whole time.

li.label: the axe felt wrong
li.description: I felled a tree while the green was angry, and I keep hearing it come down.

li.label: watched from very high
li.description: I looked up at that high, clear sky, and something looked back. It was strange, and it was beautiful.
